title: Hiring headcount + interview-loop prep (scratchpad)
content:
Purpose (quick)
- Prep notes for 1:1 with Matt (hiring cadence + interview loop tweaks) + headcount sync with People Ops.
- Capture decisions I want to land: prioritize platform infra HC this quarter, tighten loop to 3 interviews for SWE2, ensure consistent debrief rubric.

Headcount snapshot (ask People Ops to confirm numbers during sync)
- Committed HC: 18 (total eng-platform)
- Filled: 12
- Recruiting pipeline: 4 active offers (1 verbal), 2 in final-stage interviews
- Open reqs target: 4 more to reach plan — highest priority: Serving Runtime (+2), Observability (+1), Tech Lead — infra (+1)
- Budget note: finance sign-off needed for extra Serving Runtime headcount if we go above 2 net adds this quarter. Put this on Matt + finance agenda.

Hiring priorities and rationale
- #1 Serving Runtime engineers: short-term latency SLO work and quantization initiatives require 2 more hands. Risk: degraded rollout timelines for Dedicated if we don't hire.
- #2 Observability engineer (sre/platform): to support longer retention traces in console (cost delta tradeoff).
- #3 Senior infra lead (hiring stretch) — prefer internal promotion, start search only if candidate pipeline weak by EOW Mar 26.

Interview loop (proposed tightened loop for SWE2/SWE3)
- Stage 0: Recruiter screen (30m) — culture fit, basics, salary expectation, notice period.
- Stage 1: Take-home or short pairing exercise (optional for SWE3+). Keep to 48h turnaround.
- Stage 2: Technical deep-dive (60m) — algorithmic + system design micro (system-oriented for platform roles). Use same prompt for consistency.
- Stage 3: Cross-team collaboration + product-sense (45m) — how candidate communicates with PM/CS.
- Stage 4: Hiring manager debrief + final (30m) — role fit, async rubric.
Notes: aim to cap loop at 3 interviews for SWE2 (recruiter + tech deep-dive + HM) unless red flags. For senior roles keep 4.

Standardized debrief rubric (quick template to share)
- Score scale: 1-5 (1 = no, 3 = maybe, 5 = strong hire) across: Technical (T), System design (S), Collaboration/Communication (C), Impact/Ownership (I).
- Summary line: "Decision: Hire / No-hire / Consider (prefers hold)" + 2–3 sentence justification and top 2 risks.
- Always capture: reference check needed? yes/no; expected comp band; earliest start date.

Candidate queue notes (anonymized)
- Candidate A — SWE2 (platform infra). Had good systems answers; weaker on latency micro-optimizations. Next: tech deep-dive scheduled 2026-03-15 with Marcus. Need to send challenge link.
- Candidate B — SWE3 (serving runtime). Strong on kernel selection/quantization questions; wants remote-first. Recruiter indicates comp expectation slightly above band. Action: check budget and talk to finance.
- Candidate C — Senior SRE. Two take-homes, one failed due to time management. Do not progress unless exceptional.

Operational blockers to raise in meeting
- Interviewer bandwidth: Marcus and Sam overloaded; consider pulling in Jenna or external interviewers from infra-eng to keep cadence.
- Slow Greenhouse updates: delays in moving candidates to offers — ask People Ops to audit last-week update latency.
- Reference check turnaround: currently ~6 days; target <3 days for finalists. People Ops action.

Meeting asks (what I want from Matt + People Ops)
- Confirm HC approvals for +2 Serving Runtime this quarter (decision point).
- Approve using external contracting buffer for urgent kernel work while hires finalize (cost trade-off).
- Agree to the tightened loop for SWE2 (limit to 3 interviews) and standard rubric adoption across platform.
- Approve bumping comp band for SWE3 if candidate B cannot be accommodated in current band — need finance sign-off.

Draft agenda for 1:1/headcount sync (10–15 min)
- Quick numbers (current filled vs target) — 2 min
- Priorities and risks (Serving runtime + observability) — 4 min
- Approvals needed: HC and comp band — 4 min
- Ops blockers (interviewer bandwidth, GH delays) + next steps — 3–5 min

Action items (who/when)
- Aisha: Send revised interview prompts for tech deep-dive to Marcus and Jenna — by 2026-03-14.
- Marcus: Run Candidate A tech deep-dive (scheduled 2026-03-15) and submit debrief within 24h.
- Jenna / People Ops (Jenna is PO contact): Validate HC approvals and confirm finance sync slot — by 2026-03-18.
- People Ops: Audit Greenhouse move latency and provide a short report — by 2026-03-19.
- Matt: Decide on +2 Serving Runtime HC and confirm budget path — by 2026-03-18.

Loose ideas / follow-ups (brainstorm)
- Create a one-pager "platform hiring playbook" with example prompts, rubric, and normalised comp bands. Keep in Confluence and link from GH job postings.
- Experiment: assign a rotating "interview concierge" (1 PM/week) to triage schedules and ensure debriefs happen in 48h.
- Consider a short (30m) calibration session for all interviews for Serving Runtime role to align expectations — optional but might reduce hiring variance.

Notes to self (short)
- Keep pressure on reducing loop time; metric target: median time from screen to offer < 21 days.
- Remember to ask Matt about next quarter's hiring runway at the exec sync.
- Bring up reference process optimization with People Ops next week.

Unresolved questions to prep before sync
- If finance refuses extra HC, what's the fallback? Can we reprioritize internal transfers or contractors?
- Should we require take-home for all senior candidates? pros/cons to list.

End.
